shortBio.en: The Cranberries vocals; yodel-tinged alto and Irish indie-pop hooks on 90s alt radio.
shortBio.zh: The Cranberries 人声；带 yodel 色彩的中音与 90 年代 alt 电台上的爱尔兰 indie-pop 钩子。

whyHub.en: Voice = band identity: Linger / Zombie-era mass recognition sits on O’Riordan’s delivery, not a guitar brand.
whyHub.zh: 人声 = 乐队身份：Linger / Zombie 时期大众辨识落在 O’Riordan 吐字，而非吉他品牌。

body.en:
Born 1971, Limerick. Joins The Cranberries 1990. Everybody Else Is Doing It… and No Need to Argue put Linger and Zombie on 90s alt/MTV—soft arpeggio verses against louder chorus grind on Zombie. Band pauses 2003–09; reunions continue until her death 2018.

Hub: Irish alt-pop’s international face is a vocal method; Hogan brothers’ guitar frame supports it.
body.zh:
1971 年生于利默里克。1990 加入 The Cranberries。Everybody Else Is Doing It… 与 No Need to Argue 把 Linger、Zombie 送上 90 年代 alt/MTV——Zombie 上柔和分解主歌对更响副歌碾压。2003–09 乐队间歇；重聚至 2018 她去世。

枢纽：爱尔兰 alt-pop 的国际面孔是一种人声方法；Hogan 兄弟吉他框架支撑它。

note.zh: 90 年代 alt 电台巅峰任期。
